headline: Congress takes a long recess with pro forma sessions holding the fort through Monday.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate convened in pro forma session on Thursday, August 13, meeting for just over one minute before adjourning until Monday. Pro forma sessions are brief procedural meetings that keep the chamber technically in session during breaks.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met briefly in pro forma session on Thursday, August 13, lasting just three minutes. Twenty-seven bills and three resolutions were introduced during the session, though no votes were taken.
